title.narrative: Municipalities for Youth in Kosovo Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve the socioeconomic inclusion of at least 3,000 marginalized youth in vulnerable communities in Kosovo through youth-driven civic engagement and skills building activities.
